user.title: Connect a network to a zone
user.description: Select an existing network integration and an active geographic zone. Setup leaves existing trackers unchanged; eligible new client trackers receive this zone.

error.invalid_source: Choose an existing UniFi Network or MikroTik Router entry.
error.invalid_zone: Choose an existing active zone; passive zones are not supported.

abort.already_configured: This source already has a zone rule.

change_zone.title: Change target zone
change_zone.description: Choose the new zone. The next screen previews every currently managed tracker that would change; nothing is written yet.

confirm_zone_change.title: Confirm target zone change

audit.title: Review mismatched tracker zones
audit.description: Found {count} trackers whose associated zone differs from {target}. Select all or individual trackers to repair. This review makes no changes.

error.invalid_selection: Select at least one listed tracker.

abort.zone_preview_stale: The rule or its trackers changed after the preview. Review the zone change again.
